description: Generic text section with an optional image or content panel. Supports five structural layouts: text-only, image-left, image-right, centered, text-panel.

content_requirement.message: needs at least one of: body, body_items, or panel content (panel_heading / panel_body / panel_items / a panel CTA)

id.description: Optional HTML id attribute for anchor linking (e.g. navigation anchors).

title.description: Section heading. Omit to render the body without a heading.

title_accent.description: Optional exact substring of title to render in an accent color. Must match title exactly (case-sensitive) or it is ignored.

eyebrow.description: Optional short kicker/label rendered as a pill above the title.

subheading.description: Optional supporting line below the title (distinct from body, the section's main content).

title_align.description: Alignment of the eyebrow/title/subheading header block. 'start' = left-aligned (default, unchanged historical behavior). 'center' = centered.

body.description: The section's main prose surface. Rich HTML (sanitized via wp_kses_post): block-level markup, lists, headings, and links are allowed. Optional (#488): omit it for a body_items-only 'trust strip' or a panel-only band. The section must still carry SOME renderable content — see content_requirement — so a fully-empty section is rejected.

image_url.description: Image URL. Required for image-left and image-right layouts; ignored in text-only.

image_alt.description: Alt text for the image. Use empty string for decorative images.

image_id.description: Media Library attachment ID for the image (NOT a URL). When it resolves to a real attachment, the image renders responsively with srcset/sizes via wp_get_attachment_image() instead of a single fixed-size . Falls back to image_url when unset or unresolvable. Get an attachment id via the import_media apply.

layout.description: Column layout. 'centered' centers text with no image (image_url suppressed). 'text-panel' places the text column beside a styleable content panel (panel_heading/panel_body/panel_items + panel CTA) on the right at >=768px, stacked text-then-panel on mobile. Falls back to text-only if image_url is empty for image layouts, or if a text-panel layout has no panel content.

theme.description: Background color/tone for this band. 'default' = the band's own default background (no tone override). 'muted' = light tinted surface band (renders the --color-surface background with framing top and bottom borders). 'inverted' = inverted dark background for strong contrast; use 'inverted' for a genuinely dark band.

background_image.description: Optional background image URL. When set, renders as a CSS background-image with a dark overlay for text readability. Combines with any theme. Text automatically uses light colors for contrast.

panel_heading.description: text-panel layout only: heading of the right-hand content panel (rendered as an <h3>). Ignored by other layouts.

panel_body.description: text-panel layout only: optional plain-text intro paragraph inside the panel, above the list. Escaped as text (no HTML). Distinct from panel_items, which renders as a bulleted list.

panel_items.description: text-panel layout only: array of panel list entries. Each entry is EITHER a plain-text string (rendered as a bulleted list item, unchanged) OR a paired-row object { label, value } (rendered as a two-part row: label on the left, value on the right at >=768px; below that the pair stacks label-above-value on one shared left edge with the label set smaller and tracked and the value carrying the weight, a fixed responsive default with no slot behind it, so a long value gets the panel's full measure instead of a narrow right-aligned column and the pair still reads as label-then-fact — for a spec sheet, pricing summary, stat readout, or config list). Both label and value are plain text, escaped like the string form; an entry with neither renders nothing. String and paired-row entries may be mixed in one array. A paired-row entry may carry an optional per-row `style` map (see items.style) to emphasise or de-emphasise that one row. Non-scalar or empty entries are skipped.

label.description: Paired-row entry: the left-hand label (e.g. 'Plan', 'Uptime'). Plain text, escaped.

value.description: Paired-row entry: the right-hand value (e.g. 'Pro', '99.9%'). Plain text, escaped.

style.description: Optional per-row style overrides for THIS paired row only. Accepts ONLY the row-scoped style slots flagged item_eligible in styling.style_slots (today: --section-panel-text, the panel text colour), letting one row read in a different colour to emphasise or de-emphasise it against its siblings. No new colour grammar and no semantic enum — the same shared style engine validates it exactly like a component-level style (unknown or section-scoped slot names and invalid values are rejected). Rendered as inline custom properties on this row, so a per-row slot overrides the panel-level value by cascade proximity. Set via the composition (update_component / update_composition / create_page), not style_component (which is component-scoped). String entries do not take a style map.

panel_cta_text.description: text-panel layout only: label of the panel's call-to-action button. The button renders only when both panel_cta_text and panel_cta_url are set.

panel_cta_url.description: text-panel layout only: destination URL of the panel's call-to-action button (passed through esc_url). Accepts an absolute URL, a site-relative /path, an #anchor, mailto:, or tel:; a disallowed protocol (javascript:, data:) is rejected at write time. The button renders only when both panel_cta_text and panel_cta_url are set.

panel_cta_variant.description: text-panel layout only: style of the panel CTA button (shares the .btn variants). 'primary' = filled accent, 'secondary' = muted surface fill, 'outline' = accent border, 'ghost' = borderless. On a dark panel, 'primary' (accent fill with light label) and 'outline' both read well.

panel_items_marker.description: text-panel layout only: list marker for the string entries of panel_items. 'disc' (default) is the plain bulleted list, unchanged. 'check' renders a check mark, 'dash' an en dash, 'arrow' a rightwards arrow. The marker colour is authorable via the --section-panel-marker-color style slot (defaults to the site accent), so a check-list on a dark panel can be re-coloured. Just a marker choice — not a distinct list type. Paired-row entries ({ label, value }) are not list bullets and never render a marker, regardless of this value.

body_marker.description: List marker for top-level <ul> lists in body. 'disc' (default) leaves body lists exactly as before. 'check' renders a check mark, 'dash' an en dash, 'arrow' a rightwards arrow. Applies only to lists authored as a direct child of the body (nested lists keep their disc). The marker colour is authorable via the --section-body-marker-color style slot (defaults to the site accent). Just a marker choice — not a distinct list type.

body_items.description: Optional row of short inline text items (a 'trust strip' or meta row) rendered as a single centered flex row below the body, with a CSS-generated middot separator between each item. Each entry is a plain-text string (escaped, no HTML); at most 8 items, each at most 80 characters — a write that exceeds either bound, or carries a non-string entry, is rejected. Renders only when non-empty; when both body and body_items are set the row renders after the body. The items inherit the section body type (--section-body-size / --section-body-weight), so a 15px/600 strip needs no extra typography slots. Colour the separator with the --section-separator-color style slot (defaults to the muted text colour; light on inverted/background-image bands like sibling text). Not for multi-line content — use body or panel_items for that.

--section-padding-top.description: Top padding of the band. Defaults to the shared symmetric band rhythm (fluid ~68-80px desktop, ~54px mobile); set an explicit length to override.

--section-padding-bottom.description: Bottom padding of the band. Defaults to the shared symmetric band rhythm; set an explicit length to override.

--section-heading-measure.description: Maximum width of the section TITLE. Default "none" (uncapped), and section is deliberately EXEMPT from the shared --measure-heading token: section is the most-used band in the product and its title has never carried a cap, so adopting the shared 40rem would re-wrap every stored section heading. Set a length to hold a long title to a reading measure on this band only; "none" restores the default.

--section-heading-accent-color.description: Color of the title_accent substring within the title, if set

--section-eyebrow-radius.description: Eyebrow pill corner radius. Set a large value (e.g. 999px) for a fully rounded pill.

--section-eyebrow-border-width.description: Eyebrow pill border width. Set a non-zero width (with --section-eyebrow-border-color) for an outlined pill; 0 (default) renders no border.

--section-eyebrow-border-color.description: Eyebrow pill border color. Takes effect when --section-eyebrow-border-width is non-zero.

--section-eyebrow-text-transform.description: Eyebrow pill letter-casing. Default uppercase renders the kicker in caps; set none to keep it as authored (e.g. sentence case), or lowercase / capitalize.

--section-subheading-margin-bottom.description: Space between the subheading and the content below it

--section-heading-margin-bottom.description: Space between the title and the subheading below it

--section-body-measure.description: Maximum width of the section CONTENT column. The default is NOT one value — it is four, selected by layout and viewport: the outer body wrapper caps at 40rem and the inner content column at 42rem on the base layouts; the text-only and centered layouts cap at var(--measure-centered) (56rem); and below 768px text-only caps at 49rem. Setting this slot replaces ALL FOUR branches with the single value you write, at every layout and viewport — so choose a value that reads well at 375 as well as at 1440.

--section-image-position.description: image-left/image-right image focal point (object-position) — where the image crops from when its aspect ratio doesn't match --section-image-aspect-ratio

--section-image-aspect-ratio.description: image-left/image-right image aspect ratio (e.g. '16/9', '1'). Default 'auto' preserves the image's natural proportions

--section-overlay-bg.description: Background image overlay color or gradient (e.g. a transparent-to-dark scrim for text legibility over an image)

--section-shadow.description: Box shadow of the section (preset var(--shadow-sm|md|lg) or a bounded box-shadow)

--section-panel-bg.description: text-panel layout: background color or gradient of the right-hand content panel

--section-panel-border-color.description: text-panel layout: border color of the content panel

--section-panel-border-width.description: text-panel layout: border width of the content panel

--section-panel-radius.description: text-panel layout: corner radius of the content panel

--section-panel-padding.description: text-panel layout: inner padding of the content panel

--section-panel-text.description: text-panel layout: text color inside the content panel (heading, body, list, and paired rows) — set a light value for a dark panel. item_eligible: also settable per paired-row via panel_items[].style, where it recolours that single row to emphasise or de-emphasise it against its siblings.

--section-panel-font.description: text-panel layout: font family of the content panel. Defaults to inherit (the panel uses the page font, unchanged). Set to var(--font-mono) for a monospace panel (spec sheets, config/stat readouts), or any comma-separated font stack.

--section-panel-marker-color.description: text-panel layout: marker (glyph) color of the panel list when panel_items_marker is check/dash/arrow. Mirrors grid's --grid-item-bullet-color. Set a light value for a check-list on a dark panel. Ignored while panel_items_marker is 'disc'.

--section-panel-cta-bg.description: text-panel layout: RESTING fill color of the panel's FILLED (primary) call-to-action button. Set a flat color to replace the premium gradient with a solid brand fill — the gradient is a background-IMAGE, so only this slot (not a plain background color) can clear it. When --section-panel-cta-color is unset the ink stays the default light button text, so pick a fill dark enough to carry it, or set the ink slot too. The border FOLLOWS this fill when the global --btn-border-color is unset, so a fill-only recolor keeps a matching ring. Applies to panel_cta_variant 'primary' only: outline/ghost/secondary keep their transparent treatment. Governs the RESTING state only — a flat fill reverts to the premium gradient on hover, and the hover ring follows the theme accent rather than the fill. Ignored unless the panel renders a CTA (both panel_cta_text and panel_cta_url set).

--section-panel-cta-color.description: text-panel layout: text (ink) color of the panel's FILLED (primary) call-to-action button. Pair with --section-panel-cta-bg to keep the label legible on a brand fill. Applies to panel_cta_variant 'primary' only. Ignored unless the panel renders a CTA.

--section-panel-cta-shadow.description: text-panel layout: box shadow of the panel's FILLED (primary) call-to-action button. Set to `none` for a FLAT button (removes the gradient bevel/drop shadow on rest AND hover); pair with --section-panel-cta-bg (a flat color) and --section-panel-cta-color (ink) for a fully flat panel CTA. Applies to panel_cta_variant 'primary' only. Ignored unless the panel renders a CTA.

--section-body-marker-color.description: Marker (glyph) color of body lists when body_marker is check/dash/arrow. Ignored while body_marker is 'disc'.

--section-separator-color.description: Colour of the CSS-generated middot separator between body_items entries. Defaults to the muted text colour; on inverted and background-image bands it follows the light on-inverted/on-overlay text colour like sibling text unless set. Ignored when body_items is empty.

--section-inline-items-align.description: Per-line alignment of the body_items row when it wraps. 'start' (default, unchanged behaviour): each wrapped line packs from the left and the leading separator is clipped, so no middot ever dangles at the start of a line. 'center': each wrapped line is centred; the separator moves to a TRAILING middot after every item except the last. TRADE (documented, not a bug): a centred line ends mid-box, so the trailing middot at a wrap point stays VISIBLE as a subtle continuation dot at line ends — there is no pure-CSS centred-and-artifact-free option. Pick 'center' when the brand's art direction wants a centred strip at every width and accepts the subtle line-end dots; pick 'start' (default) for artifact-free left-packing. A single-line row reads centred in both modes. Ignored when body_items is empty.

accent-panel.description: Accent-tinted background with subtle border framing

spacious-editorial.description: Wide body with generous padding for long-form content
